dateline: BTS completed two sold-out nights at Bogotá's El Campín (Oct 2-3), their first-ever Colombia shows, opening the ARIRANG World Tour's South American leg.
heroHeadline: Day 4,864: BTS Head to Lima After Colombia Debut
heroSubtitle: October 7, 2026 is Day 4,864 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After two sold-out nights at Bogotá's El Campín (Oct 2-3), the ARIRANG World Tour moves to Lima's Estadio San Marcos on Oct 9-10, with Santiago, Buenos Aires and São Paulo to follow.
